title: Statement on US government directive to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5
summary: Anthropic issued an official statement regarding compliance with a US government directive requiring suspension of access to their Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models, sparking significant discussion about government regulation of AI technology.
problem_solved: This content documents the regulatory compliance response to government-imposed restrictions on AI model access rather than solving a technical problem.
why_valuable: This announcement represents a significant precedent for government intervention in AI access, affecting developers and enterprises relying on these models.
